newsitem.title: USA: Florida East Coast says Thornton to retire.
newsitem.headline: Florida East Coast says Thornton to retire.

text.p: Florida East Coast Industries Inc said at the annual meeting Tuesday that W.L. Thornton would be retiring as chairman and chief executive officer.

The company said Thornton would be replaced by Carl Zellers Jr, the company's president and chief operating officer. Zellers' appointment was approved unanimously by the board of directors after the meeting, Florida East Coast said.
A spokesman said Zellers will retain the title of president and the company will not have a chief operating officer.
